ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Plants are at what level of the food web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is “Trophic level”. On the left is a terrestrial food chain, labeled from bottom to top as Plant, Grasshopper, Mouse, Snake, Hawk, and upward arrows are used to indicate that energy or predation relationships are transmitted from plants to higher levels. On the right, an aquatic food chain is also shown. Reasoning: The question asks “Plants are at what level of the food web?” In trophic levels, the producers at the bottom level are Level 1; in the figure, Plant is located at the bottom of the terrestrial food chain and is a producer. Therefore plants are at Level 1.
